changelog.change: Initial shape: one row per date, run and work shard.
changelog.why: The published machine series moved onto the two ledgers that survive.

description: One work shard of one run, as its machine and its items reported it.

cached_tokens.description: Prompt tokens the shard reused from the cache instead of reading. Read beside `read_tokens`: the two together are every prompt token the shard needed.
cached_tokens.title: Cached Tokens

cgroup_peak_bytes.description: What the container accounted to the shard, at its highest.
cgroup_peak_bytes.title: Cgroup Peak Bytes

cpu_busy_pct.description: The lowest share of processor time any of the shard's items spent busy. The item ledger's `Watch` over the model window, not a whole-job figure: a low reading says that item waited rather than computed.
cpu_busy_pct.title: Cpu Busy Pct

cpu_model.description: The processor the host drew, in its own words, from the machine record at this key. Null where the record did not reach the shard.
cpu_model.title: Cpu Model

items.description: Item rows the shard committed with both of a model call's token cells. The denominator every fold below was taken over, so a total made from three items of forty is readable as one.
items.title: Items

job_seconds.description: The shard job's own wall clock, from the machine record.
job_seconds.title: Job Seconds

llama_rss_peak_bytes.description: The model server's memory high-water mark over the shard's items.
llama_rss_peak_bytes.title: Llama Rss Peak Bytes

longest_sequence.description: The longest prompt-plus-answer any one item reached. A maximum and never a sum - it is read against the configured context window, and a sum of sequences is a length no model call ever saw.
longest_sequence.title: Longest Sequence

model_load_ms.description: What the shard paid opening the weights before its first item, from the machine record. Once a job, which is this row's grain.
model_load_ms.title: Model Load Ms

n_ctx_configured.description: The context window the shard's server was started with. Carried so `longest_sequence` is readable without a config file from the same day.
n_ctx_configured.title: N Ctx Configured

python_rss_bytes.description: The pipeline process's own high-water mark.
python_rss_bytes.title: Python Rss Bytes

read_ms.description: Milliseconds the item ledger charged to prefill, added over the shard's items. The denominator of the ledger's own read rate.
read_ms.title: Read Ms

read_tokens.description: Prompt tokens the item ledger says this shard read: `input_tokens` minus `cached_tokens`, added over its items. Cached tokens are excluded because the server counts them that way, and counting them as read is the defect this pairing caught in August.
read_tokens.title: Read Tokens

server_prompt_seconds.description: Seconds the model server itself counted reading prompts. Pairs with the column above - a rate is a ratio, and the 80 percent error this pairing caught was in the numerator.
server_prompt_seconds.title: Server Prompt Seconds

server_prompt_tokens.description: Prompt tokens the model server itself counted reading, cached ones excluded. The second instrument: `read_tokens` is arithmetic over the item ledger, and arithmetic over a ledger cannot check that ledger.
server_prompt_tokens.title: Server Prompt Tokens

shard.description: Which work shard of the run this row folds.
shard.title: Shard

write_ms.description: Milliseconds the item ledger charged to decode, added over the items.
write_ms.title: Write Ms

written_tokens.description: Tokens the shard's model calls wrote, added over its items.
written_tokens.title: Written Tokens

title: MachineShardRow
